1.2.2.3-r1.burton_quote: Such things as we have been long accustomed to, though they be evil in their own nature; yet they are less offensive

1.2.2.3-r2.burton_quote: they had much rather feed on fish than flesh

1.2.2.3-r4.burton_quote: The stomach doth readily digest, and willingly entertain such meats we love most, and are pleasing to us, abhors on the other side such as we distaste
